# The New Yorker
> Reporting, profiles, breaking news, cultural coverage, podcasts, videos, and cartoons from The New Yorker.

The New Yorker is a long-running magazine and digital publication featuring journalism, criticism, fiction, poetry, humor, audio, and visual storytelling. Its site spans news and politics, arts and culture, magazine features, archives, podcasts, cartoons, and contributor pages.

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://www.newyorker.com/): Front page for current reporting, criticism, fiction, podcasts, and featured stories.
- [The Latest](https://www.newyorker.com/latest): Reverse-chronological feed of newly published articles and multimedia.
- [News](https://www.newyorker.com/news): Reporting, politics, opinion, commentary, and analysis.
- [Culture](https://www.newyorker.com/culture): Coverage of books, film, television, music, art, and ideas.
- [Humor](https://www.newyorker.com/humor): Satire, Shouts & Murmurs, Daily Shouts, and comic writing.
- [Magazine](https://www.newyorker.com/magazine): Current and recent issues of the weekly magazine.
- [Video](https://www.newyorker.com/video): Video reporting, interviews, documentaries, and animated shorts.
- [Podcasts](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast): Podcast hub for shows and audio features.

## News and Politics
- [News](https://www.newyorker.com/news): Main hub for news reporting, political analysis, and commentary.
- [The Lede](https://www.newyorker.com/news/the-lede): Fast-turn analysis of breaking events and major developments.
- [Daily Comment](https://www.newyorker.com/news/daily-comment): Short opinion pieces on politics, policy, and current affairs.
- [Q. & A.](https://www.newyorker.com/news/q-and-a): Interview format covering public figures, writers, and experts.
- [Annals of Inquiry](https://www.newyorker.com/news/annals-of-inquiry): Deep reported features on institutions, science, and public life.
- [Letter from Biden's Washington](https://www.newyorker.com/news/letter-from-bidens-washington): Washington column on the Biden era and national politics.
- [Letter from Trump's Washington](https://www.newyorker.com/news/letter-from-trumps-washington): Washington reporting and analysis centered on Trump-era politics.
- [Our Local Correspondents](https://www.newyorker.com/news/our-local-correspondents): Reporting from cities, regions, and communities across the country.

## Culture and Criticism
- [Culture](https://www.newyorker.com/culture): Main culture desk for criticism and essays across the arts.
- [Books](https://www.newyorker.com/books): Book criticism, author essays, and literary coverage.
- [Books & Fiction](https://www.newyorker.com/books-and-fiction): Combined hub for literary criticism, fiction, and poetry.
- [The Front Row](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/the-front-row): Film criticism and coverage of cinema and streaming.
- [On Television](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/on-television): Television criticism, recaps, and industry analysis.
- [The Current Cinema](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/the-current-cinema): Reviews of newly released films and notable screenings.
- [Musical Events](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/musical-events): Classical, jazz, pop, and live-performance criticism.
- [The Theatre](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/the-theatre): Reviews and essays on stage productions and performance.

## Fiction, Poetry, and Literary Work
- [Fiction & Poetry](https://www.newyorker.com/fiction-and-poetry): Hub for original fiction, poetry, and literary features.
- [Daily Fiction](https://www.newyorker.com/magazine/fiction): Archive of fiction published in the magazine.
- [Poems](https://www.newyorker.com/magazine/poems): Archive of poems published in the magazine.
- [Flash Fiction](https://www.newyorker.com/books/flash-fiction): Short fiction selected from the magazine's literary coverage.
- [Page-Turner](https://www.newyorker.com/books/page-turner): Essays on reading, writing, and literary culture.
- [Poetry Podcast](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast/poetry): Audio readings and discussion of poems from the archive.

## Humor and Cartoons
- [Humor](https://www.newyorker.com/humor): Main humor section for satire and comic essays.
- [Shouts & Murmurs](https://www.newyorker.com/humor/shouts-murmurs): Signature humor column featuring satirical prose pieces.
- [Daily Shouts](https://www.newyorker.com/humor/daily-shouts): Short topical humor published online.
- [Borowitz Report](https://www.newyorker.com/humor/borowitz-report): Satirical news by Andy Borowitz.
- [Cartoons](https://www.newyorker.com/cartoons): Cartoon hub with daily cartoons, caption contests, and archives.
- [Daily Cartoon](https://www.newyorker.com/cartoons/daily-cartoon): Single-panel cartoons published online each day.
- [Cartoon Caption Contest](https://www.newyorker.com/cartoons/contest): Weekly caption contest and finalist entries.
- [The Cartoon Lounge](https://www.newyorker.com/cartoons/the-cartoon-lounge): Essays, interviews, and features about cartooning.

## Audio and Podcasts
- [Podcasts](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast): Central directory for The New Yorker's podcast lineup.
- [The New Yorker Radio Hour](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast/the-new-yorker-radio-hour): Interviews, reporting, and cultural conversations from the magazine.
- [The Political Scene](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast/political-scene): Political analysis and interviews on current events.
- [Fiction Podcast](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast/fiction): Writers read and discuss short stories from the archive.
- [Poetry Podcast](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast/poetry): Poets read and reflect on work published in the magazine.
- [Critics at Large](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast/critics-at-large): Critics discuss culture, trends, and contemporary life.
- [In the Dark](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast/in-the-dark): Investigative audio reporting and narrative journalism.

## Video and Visual Storytelling
- [Video](https://www.newyorker.com/video): Main video hub for documentaries, interviews, and short features.
- [Documentaries](https://www.newyorker.com/video/documentaries): Short documentary films and reported visual stories.
- [The New Yorker Documentary](https://www.newyorker.com/video/the-new-yorker-documentary): Branded documentary series from the magazine.
- [Animated Cartoons](https://www.newyorker.com/video/animated-cartoons): Animated adaptations of New Yorker cartoons and humor.
- [Video Archive](https://www.newyorker.com/video): Browsable collection of published video content.
- [Podcasts on YouTube](https://www.newyorker.com/video): Video-accessible interviews and conversations from audio franchises.

## Magazine and Archive
- [Magazine](https://www.newyorker.com/magazine): Current issue and recent weekly magazine editions.
- [Archive](https://www.newyorker.com/archive): Searchable archive of past issues and articles.
- [Table of Contents](https://www.newyorker.com/magazine/table-of-contents): Contents pages for individual magazine issues.
- [Issue Covers](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/culture-desk/new-yorker-covers): Features and essays related to New Yorker covers.
- [Anniversary Archive](https://www.newyorker.com/archive): Historical access point for decades of magazine content.
- [Crossword](https://www.newyorker.com/puzzles-and-games-dept/crossword): Weekly crossword and puzzle-related material.

## Goings On and Lifestyle
- [Goings On](https://www.newyorker.com/goings-on): New York City events, performances, exhibitions, and recommendations.
- [Goings On About Town](https://www.newyorker.com/goings-on-about-town): Listings and editorial picks for city culture and nightlife.
- [Tables for Two](https://www.newyorker.com/magazine/tables-for-two): Restaurant reviews and dining coverage.
- [The Food Scene](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/kitchen-notes): Essays and criticism related to food and cooking.
- [Style](https://www.newyorker.com/culture): Fashion, design, and aesthetics coverage within the culture desk.
- [Puzzles & Games Dept.](https://www.newyorker.com/puzzles-and-games-dept): Crossword, caption contest, and interactive games hub.

## Authors and Contributors
- [Contributors](https://www.newyorker.com/contributors): Directory of writers, critics, cartoonists, and other contributors.
- [Writers](https://www.newyorker.com/contributors): Browse author pages and recent work by staff and contributors.
- [Cartoonists](https://www.newyorker.com/cartoons): Access cartoonists through the cartoons hub and related archives.
- [Podcasters](https://www.newyorker.com/podcast): Podcast hosts and featured guests across audio programs.
- [Search](https://www.newyorker.com/search): Sitewide search for articles, topics, and contributor pages.

## Newsletters and Subscriptions
- [Newsletters](https://www.newyorker.com/newsletters): Email newsletters for news, culture, humor, and recommendations.
- [Subscribe](https://subscribe.newyorker.com/subscribe/splits/newyorker/): Subscription offers for print and digital access.
- [Manage Account](https://www.newyorker.com/account): Account access for subscribers and registered readers.
- [Customer Care](https://www.newyorker.com/customer-care): Help for subscriptions, delivery, billing, and account issues.
- [Give a Gift](https://subscribe.newyorker.com/subscribe/splits/newyorker/gift): Gift subscription purchase page.
- [Digital Access](https://www.newyorker.com/activate): Activation and access setup for subscribers.
